_comment: DESIRED STATE ONLY (#14159). Nothing in this repository applies this file. An operator applies it after every prerequisite in defaults/docs/merge-queue-ci.md 'Pilot cutover' passes. Direct mode stays until then (champion.mergeMode is unset/direct).

required_status_checks._note: loom/merge-authorization is a commit status posted by `forge merge-queue group-check` (merge-group-check.yml), not a CI job: it records the Judge/Champion grant, never test success. CI Result is the test verdict.

_rationale.merge_method: MERGE only (pilot is merge-commit-only; no squash/rebase queue).
_rationale.max_entries_to_build: 1 = conservative: one group CI run (~86 runner-minutes, ci.yml) at a time on the shared runner budget. Raise only with pilot evidence.
_rationale.check_response_timeout_minutes: CI push wall time p90 is 13.9 min (merge-queue-ci.md, 2026-10-04 data); 40 min is ~3x p90, enough for a slow runner day without holding the queue for an hour. Re-derive from the baseline run before cutover.

not_part_of_this_file: any direct-push bypass for the version bump (see 'Pilot cutover (2AMLogic/loom)' steps 4-5 in defaults/docs/merge-queue-ci.md)
